title: Abijah's War Against Jeroboam
description: King Abijah of Judah delivers a speech from Mount Semaraim to Jeroboam and the army of Israel before the battle, reminding them of the Lord's covenant of salt with David and condemning the idolatry involving golden calves. Although the army of Israel is twice as large, God grants victory to Judah when the priests blow trumpets and the people cry out to the Lord. Abijah pursues Jeroboam and captures the cities of Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephraim. Jeroboam never regains his strength during Abijah's lifetime, and the Lord strikes him down so that he dies.
